contributors.label: Contributors
edit.title: Edit a page
edit.description: Suggest a change to a Visit Dhaka page. Every edit is checked by a reviewer before it appears on the site.
edit.disabled: Editing on the site isn't open yet. You can suggest a change on {{link}} instead.
edit.loadFailed: This page couldn't be loaded. Check the link, or try again later.
edit.notEditable: This page can't be edited here. Only guide pages can be edited on the site.
edit.pending: Someone has already suggested an edit to this page, and it's waiting for review. You're editing that version, and the reviewer will check your changes with it. {{link}}
edit.rules: Write in Markdown: ## for a heading, - for a list item, and [text](https://example.org) for a link. HTML isn't allowed. Opening hours, fees, prices and visa rules need an official source, so link to it. A reviewer checks every edit before it appears on the site.
edit.nameHint: Leave it empty to be credited as “Anonymous”. Don't use someone else's name.
edit.summaryHint: What did you change, and why? For example: “Added the museum's new opening hours from its website.”
edit.licence: I release my contribution under the {{link}} licence, and it's my own work or comes from a source that allows this.
edit.successTitle: Thank you! Your edit has been sent for review.
edit.successText: A reviewer will check it, usually within two days, before it appears on the site. You can follow it on GitHub: {{link}}.
edit.error.stale: This page changed while you were editing. Copy your text somewhere safe, then reload the latest version and make your change again.
edit.error.conflict: Someone else is editing this page at the same moment. Wait a minute and try again.
edit.error.turnstile_failed: The security check didn't work. Please try again.
edit.error.daily_cap_reached: We've had a lot of edits today, so new ones are paused. Please try again tomorrow.
edit.error.rate_limited: You've sent several edits in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
edit.error.request_too_large: The page is too long. Edits can be up to 50 KB.
edit.error.body_too_large: The page is too long. Edits can be up to 50 KB.
edit.error.diff_too_large: That's a very large change. Please make it as a few smaller edits.
edit.error.body_has_html: HTML isn't allowed. Use Markdown instead.
edit.error.body_has_mdx: Curly brackets { } and lines starting with import or export aren't allowed.
edit.error.body_has_unsafe_link: One of the links isn't allowed. Links must start with https:// or /.
edit.error.body_has_external_image: Images from other websites aren't allowed.
edit.error.body_has_frontmatter: The text can't start with a block between --- lines.
edit.error.body_has_control_characters: The text contains hidden control characters. Please retype the part you pasted.
edit.error.name_too_long: Names can be up to 40 characters.
edit.error.summary_too_long: Edit summaries can be up to 200 characters.
edit.error.licence_required: Please agree to release your contribution under CC BY-SA 4.0.
edit.error.network: Your edit couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
edit.signInPrompt: Have a Google account? You can sign in, so your edits are all credited to one name and listed on your own contributor page. It's optional.
edit.contributionsPending: Your contributions will be listed on your contributor page once one of your edits is published.
edit.chooseNameText: This name is shown publicly with every edit you make and on your contributor page. Once an edit is published, the name it was made under stays in the page's history permanently, even if you change it later. It doesn't have to be your full real name: a first name or a nickname works well.
edit.deleteConfirm: Delete your account? You'll be signed out. Your published edits stay in the site's history under the name you used, and your contributor page is removed the next time the site is updated. This can't be undone.
edit.error.name_reserved: Please choose a name other than “Anonymous”.
edit.error.banned: This account can't make edits. If you think this is a mistake, write to team@tingeworks.com.
edit.error.signed_out: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
edit.error.generic: Something went wrong and your edit wasn't sent. Please try again later.
consent.title: Can we use analytics cookies?
consent.text: We'd like to use Google Analytics to see which pages visitors find useful. It sets cookies and sends details of your visit to Google, so it stays off unless you agree. You can change your mind at any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page.
events.empty: Nothing is listed right now. Know about something happening in Dhaka? Suggest it and an editor will add it.
whatsOn.title: What's on in Dhaka
whatsOn.description: Festivals, national days and events happening in Dhaka now and coming up soon.
whatsOn.intro: Festivals, national days and events happening in Dhaka now and coming up soon. Dates can change, so check with the organiser or official source before you go. Know about something that's missing? {{link}}.
recentChanges.title: Recent changes
recentChanges.description: The latest changes to pages on Visit Dhaka, newest first.
recentChanges.intro: The latest changes to pages on Visit Dhaka, newest first, in Dhaka time. Edits from the public are reviewed before they're published. Names are as each contributor gave them and aren't verified. The full history is on {{link}}.
profile.description: Edits to Visit Dhaka by {{name}}, a signed-in contributor.
profile.intro: {{name}} has had {{count}} edits published on Visit Dhaka. Every edit is checked by a reviewer before it appears on the site.
profile.introOne: {{name}} has had {{count}} edit published on Visit Dhaka. Every edit is checked by a reviewer before it appears on the site.
profile.note: This page lists edits made while signed in, under the account's current display name. Each edit also keeps the name it was made under in the page's history.
account.title: Your account
account.description: Change the name you edit under, sign out, or delete your Visit Dhaka account.
account.disabled: Accounts aren't open yet. You can still suggest an edit to any page without one.
account.unavailable: Your account can't be loaded right now. Please try again later.
account.signedOut: You're not signed in. Accounts are optional: you can suggest an edit to any page without one, using its “Edit page” link.
account.deleteText: Your account is removed straight away and you're signed out. Your published edits stay in the site's history under the name you used at the time, and your contributor page is removed the next time the site is updated. This can't be undone.
